synthetic_notice: Fictional structured policies for prototype evaluation. Not real policies. All rules are invented for testing purposes.

policies.description: Trailer segments must not violate the audience content-rating ceiling. A segment is rejected if it contains a windowed sensitivity flag whose required minimum rating exceeds the audience ceiling.

No trailer segment may include a source interval that overlaps a protected-fact reveal window if the spoiler level exceeds the audience allowed maximum. MAJOR spoilers are never permitted in any trailer.

rule.override_note: Historical performance data (CTR, engagement) NEVER overrides spoiler rules.

policies.description: Marketing claims associated with a segment must not contradict the authoritative story_facts.json. Forbidden claim patterns are specified in story_facts.json. Relationship claims must match documented public relationships.

Dialect subtitle cues must have native_review != REJECTED. PENDING triggers WARN (human-review flag). PASS is required for APPROVED status. Semantic meaning_tags must match the aligned hi cue. Dialect must not be used as a purely comic device.
Any scene with audio_only_key_info=true must have at least one subtitle cue fully inside every segment window drawn from that scene. Silent segments are exempt.

Each trailer total duration must fall within the episode-level trailer_duration_window. Segments must not overlap. source_in < source_out for every segment. Segments must lie within their declared scene bounds.
Total estimated API cost for the run must not exceed run_budget. If full profile exceeds budget, fallback to lite profile is mandated. If lite profile also exceeds budget, run is rejected.
